name: dangerous-patterns
description: Broad HTML attack surface including script tags, event handlers, SVG, form actions, meta refresh, srcdoc, active containers, and encoded payloads.

name: preservation-cases
description: Benign pages and fragments with tables, forms, links, semantic HTML, and dense attributes that should survive filtering.

name: normalization-stress
description: Malformed or layered inputs that become dangerous only after browser normalization, entity decoding, percent decoding, or wrapper insertion.
